name: MultiMaster
blurb: The oscillating tool that invented the category, and still the standard. One body: saw, scraper, sander, detail cutter, for jobs a circular saw can’t reach. Dense, vibration kept in check. If the kit has one specialty power tool, this is it.

name: CXS 18 Compact Drill
blurb: A compact cordless drill. Short and balanced, for hangings, furniture, and light assembly. Festool’s clutch and electronics make clean holes and careful seating the default. The work a house needs, without the bulk of a full-size driver.

name: E20C Claw Hammer
blurb: One-piece forged steel, leather grip, balance that settles on the first swing. Picture hanging, trim, light framing. This is the hammer.

name: DFH12 Dead Blow Mallet
blurb: A dead-blow mallet for force without scars. Shot-filled head, no rebound. For seating joints, stuck parts, and assembly where a steel hammer would mark the work. It sits next to the claw hammer.

name: SwissGrip Screwdriver Set
blurb: Swiss-made drivers. Precise tips, real torsion, grips that stay planted. Covers the fasteners a house actually has. The set that stays in the drawer.

name: ESD Micro Bit Set
blurb: Bits for electronics, eyeglasses, small appliances, and the fasteners full-size drivers can’t reach. Organized, precise, ESD-safe. For the fine work. Then put it away.

name: Type 81S Torpedo Level
blurb: A pocket torpedo that reads true. Clear vials, die-cast body. Hangings, shelves, appliance leveling. This is the level.

name: Self-Centering 25' Tape
blurb: A 25-foot tape with self-centering scales, so a midpoint is not extra math. Sturdy blade, clean printing, a hook that behaves. Measuring is the first step of a decent install.

name: ST-350 Toolbox
blurb: A compact steel toolbox. Rigid, well finished, small enough to leave out. Holds a kit without becoming a junk drawer. Storage is how good tools stay good.

name: Pliers Set
blurb: German pliers. Gripping, cutting, adjustment. Jaws that meet cleanly, handles that hold. Fixtures, fasteners, wire, the stuck nut. Fewer pairs. Better ones.
